changelog:
Initial release of clawguard-security — AI agent security scanner & sanitizer.

- Provides local security scanning, PII sanitization, and intent-action mismatch detection for agent skills.
- Implements automated, enforced rules for scanning new skills, protecting secrets, verifying intent, periodic security patrol, and checking suspicious messages.
- No cloud dependency — all analysis and sanitation runs locally for privacy.
- Supports over 285 threat patterns, including OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 coverage.
- Command line interface for scan, sanitize, intent-check, and audit commands included.
- Encourages community feedback on false positives and missed attacks.
